column1: # Every card id a pack has carried: the target language, then the tgtLemma.
# A card is filed as target:tgtLemma, so a headword shipped once is a card
# somebody may have, and a seed edit that respells it strands every such
# card under an id no pack reads. Nothing in the build notices. So a line
# here is never deleted: tests/tools/card-ids.test.ts fails on a line whose
# word no pack teaches, unless RENAMED in src/core/renames.ts moves it to
# one that does, and on a word a pack teaches that has no line here.
# A new word is one line. A respelt word keeps its old line and gains the new
# one, and its old spelling goes into RENAMED. Sorted by code unit, as
# JavaScript sorts, so a new line has one place to go.
# Taken 2026-10-04 from the packs as they stood, which held every id the
# published 1.0.0 packs did, and the four homograph seconds added since.
